title: CARRY:
body: CARRY: the spine's deletion left a product render for this code alone — crates/conductor-report/tests/matrix_ledger_gate.rs reads each version's requirements.md and verification-matrix.json, retired files that .andromeda/db/moved keeps rendered until this flips. Flip it in this chunk: read each version's coverage.md, whose "- {id} · {title}" lines name every capability once, and hold the unique and no-P-NNN arms there; the set-equality arm has no subject now, since a requirement's line lives on its capability node. Then fire rec.py render --root . --family spine --reconcile --product none and git rm the six files, in this chunk's commit.
